title: Playbook
description: playbooks/<name>.yaml (03 §4). Templates use {{ inputs.* }}, {{ item.* }} (fan-out item), {{ steps.<id>.output.* }} and, in triggers, {{ event.* }}.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the mission inputs.

team.description: Every step agent must be in the team.

four_eyes.description: When true the mission starter cannot approve its writes.

data_class.description: Initial mission class; default from routing_policy.default_mission_class.

baseline_minutes.description: Human time one run replaces, for Analytics (hours saved = baseline × completed).

over.description: steps.<id>.output.<path to a list> (the source step needs an output schema) or steps.<id>.outputs (all outputs of a fan-out step).

when.description: Expression evaluated per item; items where it is false are skipped.

schema.description: Path of a JSON Schema relative to the pack (schemas/x.json, ../dev/schemas/x.json).

inputs_from.description: Fan-in: steps.<id>.outputs is the list of all outputs of a fan-out step.

when.description: Expression over earlier outputs; the step is skipped when false.

writes.description: Full operation ids this step may propose. propose_action is only available in steps that list writes.

credentials.description: service (default) or user (only when the starter or trigger owner is that user).

cron.description: schedule triggers, 5-field cron, UTC unless timezone is set.

event.description: gitlab/jira event name, e.g. merge_request, issue.

filter.description: Kind-specific filter, e.g. {label: security, action: [open, update]}.

owner_user.description: Identity triggered missions run as (user credentials, budgets, audit).

inputs.description: Mission inputs, templated; event triggers use {{ event.* }}.

auto_start.description: false creates a Task on the board instead of starting a mission.
